title: The ALMA Fornax Cluster Survey I: stirring and stripping of the molecular gas in cluster galaxies
question: Does the cluster environment affect the molecular gas in Fornax cluster galaxies, and which processes are responsible?

what.value: Stellar masses for many targets and Herschel FIR detections
xCOLD GASS field control sample median gas fractions

evidence.quote: We use the relation based on the median values that they obtained by subdividing the sample in bins based on their stellar mass (cite: Saintonge2017)

what.value: Cluster mean velocity 1493 km/s and dispersion 374 km/s

evidence.quote: The mean velocity and velocity dispersion of the Fornax cluster were taken from (cite: Drinkwater2001a), and equal 1493 km s$^{-1}$and 374 km s$^{-1}$, respectively.
an already reduced image of NGC1365 was taken from the ALMA archive
Its atomic hydrogen mass is $M_{\text{H{\sc i} }} = 2.1 \times 10^9 M_\odot$ (cite: Lee-Waddell2018)

recipe.method: Manual CASA calibration, tclean with natural weighting, uvcontsub, impbcor
key_parameters: 10 km/s channels (2 km/s for FCC207, FCC261), 0.5" pixels

recipe.goal: Make moment maps, PVDs and spectra
recipe.method: Masked moment method with smoothed-cube mask clipped at 3 or 4 sigma; PVD from beam-wide slit along major axis
key_parameters: velocity smoothing 4 channels; clip at 3 or 4 sigma

recipe.method: Visual inspection of moment 0 and 1 maps: regular vs disturbed

recipe.goal: Measure line flux and derive H2 masses
recipe.method: Gaussian fit or direct box integration; M_H2 from CO flux with metallicity-dependent X_CO (Accurso+2017), metallicity from stellar mass
assumptions: D = 19.95 Mpc; alpha_CO multiplied by 2.14e20 for X_CO; stellar M/L = 1 at 3.6 um

recipe.method: 3 sigma limits assuming Gaussian line of FWHM 50 km/s, peak 3x rms in inner PB-corrected cube
Compare M_H2/M_star with xCOLD GASS median relation (log interpolation/extrapolation); deficiency = log observed - log expected; KS and Mann-Whitney tests vs. cluster radius

evidence.quote: CO was detected (at $> 3 \sigma$) in 15 of the 30 galaxies observed.
Galaxies with regular CO emission have an average H$_2$ deficiency of -0.50 dex
galaxies with disturbed CO emission have an average H$_2$ deficiency of -1.1 dex
The resulting metallicity, assuming these relations hold, is $12 + \text{log}(\text{O/H})$ = 8.12 (or 0.27 $Z_\odot$).

not_stated_but_needed: Which galaxies had continuum subtracted and the line-free channel ranges
Clean masks, thresholds and iteration limits
Mosaic pointing layouts and phase/bandpass calibrators other than flux calibrators
Exact channel ranges and aperture boxes used for integrated spectra
Exact Gaussian-fit procedure and box boundaries
Mopra reduction scripts beyond those described
Continuum imaging parameters and spectral-index fitting method
Specifics of the xCOLD GASS interpolation for expected H2 mass
missing_for_reproduction: Line-free channel ranges and clean masks
score_reason: Public data, scripts released, clear mass/deficiency recipe; some per-galaxy choices are visual or unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, recipe is largely complete, and main results (detection counts, M_H2, deficiencies) are numeric.
